# Read mail or chat it is connected to

`read.message.tenant` — **read** × **message** at **tenant** reach (the organisation's accounts, repositories and services). Family: communication. Effect: **cannot be undone**.

## Granted by 1 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Claude.ai — connectors on](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-web/connectors-on/index.md) | ○ boundary | derived | connectors |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** a connector scoped to one folder or label, or none

**What it costs:** the agent answers about less

**Tier after:** boundary

## Questions that ask about it

- *Can it read your mail or chat?* — eliciting, reliability 0.6

## In the mandates

- **wanted** by [Chat, with connectors switched on](../../../map/mandates/chat-with-connectors/index.md)
- **not wanted** by [Chat in the browser, nothing connected](../../../map/mandates/chat-no-connectors/index.md)
